{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# First, check if there are any commas in the revenue strings
print(f"Sample revenue values with commas: {df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()}")

# Clean the revenue column
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Confirm the transformation
print(f"First 5 cleaned revenue values: {df['revenue_clean'].head().tolist()}")

# Verify that the QA orders (999999.99) are still present
qa_count = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders after cleaning: {qa_count}")"}
